jobDescription.title: Job description
jobDescription.text:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join our platform engineering team.

  • Own the payments API: latency, availability and error budgets for 2,000 requests per second.
  • Design services in Java and Go on Kubernetes, with Kafka for events and PostgreSQL for the ledger.
  • Lead incident response and postmortems; mentor two engineers.

Requirements: 6+ years building backend services. Experience with AWS and observability tooling.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text: B.Tech in Computer Science or equivalent; Kubernetes a plus.
